gateResults.gate: First repair on original source freeze
Same native first-entry cases after remote integration
gateResults.note: A rerun of the same12 cases, not12 additional unique features.

gateResults.gate: NPC data-only ZIP/GLB/IDB corruption and ownership
Native Studio→Game NPC clips, rigs, file/storage, ink

repairedUserEntryFlows: A geometry-free pixel inside oversized actor bounds now reaches native ArcRotate left-drag instead of moving the actor. True body drags retain native village hillside height plus the original foot offset; pointercancel restores transform/history.
Add uses an actual camera-center ground ray and preserves the current camera; no-ground views reject explicitly.
The focused numeric time draft survives the real500ms clock poll and stale status ACK. Enter, the visible Move action and change/blur commit the captured time once.

The actual header Open click invokes the native file input synchronously. A File change validates and automatically opens the scene or binary-audio project; choosing the same file again works. Late file reads cannot replace New work.

Existing settings checkboxes developer-nearby-enabled and developer-authoring-enabled close settings and show root-mounted in-game tools; no duplicate third checkbox. Real main lazy callbacks route nearby battle actors to the actual actor editor.

npcEvidence.sourceAnimationPolicy: All20 native channels were compared with the actual Animation.evaluate result, and source key digests remained unchanged. Runtime horizontal root-motion compensation retains the actor footprint; carrierY and original sit/rest channels are retained.
npcEvidence.futurePackage: An inert synthetic manifest/GLB metadata variant with the original model binary is imported through actual Studio File events into the production asynchronous IDB branch. Fresh normal-game UI sees it without another import. Only explicit Add requests the source. Scene files retain exact asset/version references; another device requires the same NPC package import.
npcEvidence.sharedRigPolicy: Independent native skeletons and poses, shared original geometry; no extra GLB parse for seeks or same-scene file reopen.
npcEvidence.gameEditing: A real default BossBattle.summon goblin is edited through nearby selection without replacing root, rig, AI or HP. Cancel restores all captured world matrices; Apply retains pose and clears route state. Normal gameplay AI may move it afterward.

lateColorStageRepair.finding: Actual game materials output gamma-encoded color before the first post process; raw linear ink was incorrectly mixed into that input.
lateColorStageRepair.verification: Native manager uniform bind matches exact piecewise sRGB output encoding for current gamma input, while explicit linear-input configuration retains original linear ink. Existing PP/resource ownership is unchanged.
lateColorStageRepair.historicalNote: Original model/world gates retained at their historical source hashes. Only this uniform adapter changed afterward; bounded color/configuration/ownership proof covers that delta. Root reruns whole/build on final source.

styleEvidence.implementation: NPC-specific toon bands/silhouette plus NPC-only normal/depth RTT and post process on the existing engine/camera chain. Existing world color post process survives hiding/disposal; no scene.customRenderTargets insertion and no second world depth render.
styleEvidence.independentNative: Actual supplied-model meshes register with the real native manager; only public NullEngine depth allocation is supplied because NullEngine does not provide framebuffer depth attachments. All owned model/download Blob URLs and adapters are disposed.
styleEvidence.limits: 3240 source-math probes and native lifecycle tests do not prove WebGL shader compilation, image equivalence or on-device rendering.
